A variant of the Radon transform

visual_check.note: All ten pages were rendered at 150 dpi and visually inspected. The batch contains text, formulas, proofs, and matrix displays, but no new standalone teaching figure.

key_objects.name_zh: Theorem 6.9 固定点证明收尾
key_objects.name_en: completion of the fixed-point proof of Theorem 6.9
key_objects.description: The Picard iterates converge in L^q to a fixed point u=M(u); identities (56)-(57), Proposition 6.8 and time localization verify the strong-solution properties and arbitrary-L² local existence.

key_objects.name_zh: 非线性 Schrödinger 的分布解恒等式
key_objects.name_en: distributional solution identity for the nonlinear Schrödinger equation
key_objects.formula: ∫ u L'(φ) dx dt = σ ∫ |u|^{λ-1}u φ dx dt,  L'=-1/i ∂_t-Δ

key_objects.name_zh: 非齐次解算子 S 的测试函数恒等式
key_objects.name_en: test-function identity for the inhomogeneous solution operator S
key_objects.formula: ∫ S(F)L'(φ) dx dt = ∫ Fφ dx dt

key_objects.name_zh: 强解性质的验证
key_objects.name_en: verification of the strong-solution properties
key_objects.description: Approximate F in L^p by compactly supported smooth functions, use Theorem 6.7 to pass (57) to L^p data, then Proposition 6.8 gives L²-valued continuity in time and u(·,0)=f.

key_objects.name_zh: 任意 L² 初值的局部存在性
key_objects.name_en: local existence for arbitrary L2 initial data
key_objects.description: Choose a>0 so the free evolution has L^q norm ≤δ/2 on |t|<a and repeat the same contraction argument on the restricted spacetime slab.

key_objects.name_zh: 局部化 R_B 的 Sobolev 平滑
key_objects.name_en: Sobolev smoothing for a localized R_B
key_objects.description: For a localized R'_B in d=3, ||R'_B f||_{L²_1}≤c||f||_2; for odd d the analogous order is (d-1)/2.

key_objects.name_zh: 旋转曲率
key_objects.name_en: Rotational curvature

key_objects.name_zh: 双定义函数的旋转矩阵
key_objects.name_en: rotational matrix of a double defining function
key_objects.description: For ρ(x,y), form the (d+1)×(d+1) matrix with first row (ρ,∂_{y1}ρ,…,∂_{yd}ρ), first column (ρ,∂_{x1}ρ,…,∂_{xd}ρ)^T, and mixed derivatives ∂²ρ/(∂y_j∂x_k) in the lower-right block.

key_objects.name_zh: 旋转曲率
key_objects.name_en: rotational curvature

key_objects.name_zh: 平移不变情形：旋转曲率等价于 Gauss 曲率
key_objects.name_en: translation-invariant case: rotational curvature versus Gauss curvature
key_objects.description: If ρ(x,y)=ρ(x-y), then M_x=x+M_0 and nonvanishing rotational curvature is equivalent to nonvanishing Gauss curvature of M_0.

key_objects.name_zh: R_B 情形：旋转曲率等价于 B 非退化
key_objects.name_en: R_B case: rotational curvature versus nondegeneracy of B
key_objects.description: For ρ(x,y)=y_d-x_d+B(x',y'), rotcurv(ρ)≠0 iff B is nondegenerate.

key_objects.name_zh: 旋转曲率对定义函数缩放的变换律
key_objects.name_en: transformation of rotational curvature under rescaling the defining function

key_objects.name_zh: 旋转曲率的局部微分同胚不变性
key_objects.name_en: local diffeomorphism invariance of rotational curvature

key_objects.name_zh: 一般平均算子
key_objects.name_en: general averaging operator

key_objects.name_zh: 一般 Radon 型平均算子的 L² Sobolev 平滑
key_objects.name_en: L2 Sobolev smoothing for the general Radon-type averaging operator
key_objects.statement: If rotcurv(ρ)≠0 on ρ=0, then A extends boundedly from L²(R^d) to L²_k(R^d), k=(d-1)/2.

key_objects.name_zh: 旋转曲率下 S_λ 的额外半阶衰减
key_objects.name_en: extra half-order decay for S_lambda under rotational curvature
key_objects.statement: If rotcurv(ρ)≠0 on ρ=0 and ψ is supported away from y_0=0, then ||S_λ||≤c λ^{-(d+1)/2}.

key_objects.name_zh: T* T 与核的快速离对角衰减
key_objects.name_en: T-star-T and rapid off-diagonal kernel decay
key_objects.description: Use ||T* T||=||T||² and repeated integration by parts to obtain |M(x,y)|≤c_N(λ|x-y|)^{-N}, then dominate by an L¹ convolution kernel of mass O(λ^{-d}).

key_objects.name_zh: Corollary 7.3 的升维与迹估计证明
key_objects.name_en: lift-and-trace proof of Corollary 7.3
key_objects.description: Apply (64) to F_λ(x_0,x) at x_0=1, use Proposition 7.2 in d+1 dimensions, and integrate by parts in y_0 to avoid the apparent extra λ from ∂_{x0}.
